verdict.rationale: LM Studio is a local-first app: inference, RAG and voice processing happen on the user's device, and llmster can run on servers or cloud instances. That keeps data local by architecture, but the evidence documents no product feature for choosing a storage region, residency, or data location. Choosing a region by picking which machine or cloud instance hosts it is a user-side or host-platform arrangement, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
